copy.tagline: 锁定高清画布，自由组合组件制作幻灯片

copy.tagline_en: Lock canvas at 1920x1080 and compose slides with React components
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design presentations with free-form component layout on a fixed canvas

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 会使用固定 1920×1080 画布，像搭积木一样自由排列文字、图片，不套用预设模板，且每页只突出一个视觉重点。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 做幻灯片，特别是需要独特布局、不想要现成模板时，它就会用这个技能来生成。

say.text: 帮我把这些观点做成一页自由的幻灯片。
say.note: Claude 会按 1920×1080 画布自由排布

say.text: 用 Sea Indigo 配色做三张展示页。
say.note: Claude 会选用指定调色板并保持风格统一

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude uses a fixed 1920×1080 canvas to freely arrange text and images without templates, ensuring each slide has only one visual focal point.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create slides, especially for custom layouts without templates.

say_en.text: Make a free-form slide from these points.
Create three slides using Sea Indigo palette.
say_en.note: Claude uses the specified color scheme
